note: The quest library. Each player's route (Players/<name>/route.json, written by the Game Master) can hide quests, open them early, change prerequisites, grant extra detour tokens, and add custom quests. Hints for quest X live in Quests/hints/X.md. Ratings (0 none, 1 a touch, 2 a big part, 3 the main focus) describe roughly how much of a quest goes to each region of the field; docs/QUEST_GUIDE.md is generated from them. See GAME_MASTER.md. Each quest has an animal companion that hatches when the quest is cleared (art in assets/companions/<ID>.svg).

rating_criteria.name: Pure math
rating_criteria.short: Proving things about numbers, functions and structures.

rating_criteria.name: Statistics & probability
rating_criteria.short: Proving facts about chance, data and estimators.

rating_criteria.name: Verified software & policies
rating_criteria.short: Proving that code, configurations and access rules do what they claim, for every input.

rating_criteria.name: Checking AI output
rating_criteria.short: Deciding whether a proof, statement, spec or change an AI produced is what was asked for.

rating_criteria.name: AI safety & security
rating_criteria.short: Proving a system can't do certain harmful things: flip under noise, leak a person, overspend.

rating_criteria.name: Evaluation & benchmarks
rating_criteria.short: Measuring AI systems honestly, and telling a real improvement from noise.

rating_criteria.name: Trust & auditing
rating_criteria.short: Knowing exactly what "verified" guarantees: axioms, statement fidelity, graders that can be fooled.

rating_features.name: A real AI in the loop

quests.title: Basecamp
quests.blurb: Why this game exists, a 3-minute tour of the field, and your interests. The Game Master plans your route from this.

companion.name: Ember
companion.says: Keeps the campfire going while you plan your route.

quests.title: Orientation
quests.blurb: A 20-minute tour of the moves you'll use everywhere: calculate, take apart, rewrite, the autopilots, exact?.

companion.name: Pip
companion.says: Follows the first verifier it meets. Today, that's you.

quests.title: First Contact
quests.blurb: Lean as a calculator and a lie detector: #eval, rfl, norm_num, decide.

companion.name: Ripple
companion.says: Floats on its back, checking every claim twice.

quests.title: Proof Gym
quests.blurb: Proofs rusty? Each puzzle shows the paper proof next to a mostly finished Lean version.

companion.name: Rep
companion.says: Never skips proof day.

quests.title: The Tactic Toolkit
quests.blurb: Logic moves (intro, exact, constructor, cases, rw, use), then the Island of Knights and Knaves.

companion.name: Chisel
companion.says: Has a tactic for every log.

quests.title: Induction Dojo
quests.blurb: Induction on numbers and on lists: Gauss's trick, then verifying small programs (append, reverse, sum), then the Tower of Hanoi.

companion.name: Fib
companion.says: Has 1, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8… siblings. Proved it by induction.

quests.title: The Oracle Lies
quests.blurb: An AI made nine confident claims. Prove the true ones; catch the lies.

companion.name: Delphi
companion.says: Asks every oracle: "are you SURE?"

quests.title: The RH Audit
quests.blurb: How do you trust a 17-million-line proof of the Riemann Hypothesis? Audit five suspicious submissions, then meet zeta.

companion.name: Zeta
companion.says: Sniffs out smuggled axioms.

quests.title: Spec Review
quests.blurb: An AI wrote eight statements: four from math problems, four specs for its own code. Find the four that drift (including specs so weak that wrong code passes), prove the evidence, and meet a proof that proves nothing.

companion.name: Specs
companion.says: Reads every line of the spec. Judges you a little.

quests.title: Red-Team the Grader
quests.blurb: Think like a reward-hacking AI: fool a proof grader four ways, then work out which checks catch each trick.

companion.name: Bandit
companion.says: Found three holes in the grader before breakfast. Reported all of them.

quests.title: Monty Hall, Verified
quests.blurb: Settle the most argued-about probability puzzle by counting worlds, then break it with Monty Fall.

companion.name: Monty
companion.says: Lives behind door 3. Or does it? You should switch.

quests.title: Simpson's Paradox Lab
quests.blurb: Certify the kidney-stone data, build your own paradox, and prove why it happens.

companion.name: Paradox
companion.says: Green in every group. Purple overall.

quests.title: Privacy Boss
quests.blurb: Randomized response: prove a differential-privacy guarantee and an unbiased estimator.

companion.name: Epsilon
companion.says: Shares the statistics, never the secrets.

quests.title: Bug Bounty
quests.blurb: AI-written code: prove the correct functions correct and catch the buggy ones.

companion.name: Patch
companion.says: Eats bugs. Has a proof it ate all of them.

quests.title: Neural Net Safety Check
quests.blurb: ReLU facts, a robustness certificate for a tiny classifier, and an adversarial attack.

companion.name: Robusto
companion.says: Small nudges don't change its mind.

quests.title: Build a Mini-Prover
quests.blurb: Run an LLM-plus-Lean proving loop on a mixed math-and-code benchmark, measure it, then improve it.

companion.name: Lemma
companion.says: Uses tools. Mostly Lean.

quests.title: The Policy Engine
quests.blurb: Verify a Cedar-style access-control engine: prove forbid always wins, check a company's policy over every request, and catch the leak in an AI's policy change.

companion.name: Honk
companion.says: Guards the gate. Forbid always wins.

quests.title: Vericoding
quests.blurb: An AI submitted code, a spec and a proof. Break its weak spec, write a better one, and test your spec in both directions.

companion.name: Inky
companion.says: Eight arms, one spec, zero loopholes.

quests.title: Agent Guardrails
quests.blurb: An AI agent has a company card. Jailbreak an AI-written guardrail, then prove a correct one keeps every possible agent within budget.

companion.name: Wooly
companion.says: Bounces as high as it likes. Never past the fence.

quests.title: SiblingBench
quests.blurb: Co-op: build a benchmark, test AI models with your prover, and analyze the results like a statistician.

companion.name: Tux & Tex
companion.says: Better together. Statistically significant.
